name: Pantochino Summer Theatre Camp
street_address: Milford Arts Council, 40 Railroad Avenue South
description_short: A week long musical theater camp run by Pantochino Productions at the Milford Arts Council in downtown Milford, 9 am to 3 pm. Campers rehearse an original musical for four days, with lines and songs to learn at home, and perform it on Friday.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camp page: 2027 camp weeks given for planning purposes, with details due in January. Five day sessions, four rehearsal days and a performance day. Contact details are in the page footer.

Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Theatre Camp 2026 FAQ, which says it will be updated in early 2027. Ages 8 to 12 (must be 8 by July 1), 9 am to 3 pm, air conditioned, children bring their own lunch. The 2026 price was $325 a session; not recorded because 2027 prices are not posted.
Researched by Claude from this page. Directions to the MAC: 40 Railroad Avenue South, Milford, CT 06460.

source.title: Summer Camp & Classes — Pantochino Productions Inc.

changes: Used the 2027 season: the camp has posted 2027 weeks. Left price and the cancellation policy out because only 2026 figures are posted.
for_andrew: The 2027 weeks are posted only 'for planning purposes' and the 2027 price is not out yet. Ages and the lunch rule come from the 2026 FAQ, which the camp says it will update in early 2027. Publish now or wait for January?
